description: Defines the QuicSpdyClientStream class, which manages SPDY request/response streams over QUIC, including header parsing, data sending, and response handling.

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientStream
classes.description: Manages SPDY request and response over QUIC, including header processing, data transmission, and response retrieval.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Serializes headers and body, sends the request to the server, and returns the number of bytes sent.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of initial headers, parsing and storing response headers.

methods.name: OnPromiseHeaderList
methods.description: Handles creation of push streams with promised headers.

methods.name: OnBodyAvailable
methods.description: Called when data is available for reading.

methods.name: response_headers
methods.description: Returns the headers received for this stream.

methods.name: preliminary_headers
methods.description: Returns the preliminary headers, used for 100 Continue responses.

methods.name: header_bytes_read
methods.description: Returns the number of header bytes read.

methods.name: header_bytes_written
methods.description: Returns the number of header bytes written.

methods.name: AreHeadersValid
methods.description: Validates headers received from the server.

methods.name: CopyAndValidateHeaders
methods.description: Copies and validates headers, extracting content length.

methods.name: ParseAndValidateStatusCode
methods.description: Parses and validates the response status code.
